notice: All organizations, inputs, activity and results are synthetic. This proposed workflow is not a connected employer system or measured company performance.
title: Choose the next move from the customer’s actual stage.
intro: A proposed customer-zero workbench for Kya: use product milestones and account context to distinguish onboarding help, adoption work and a justified expansion discussion.
queueIntro: Product activity, customer value and buying intent are related but different signals. Preserve the customer’s existing owner and current unresolved work.
workbenchIntro: Change the account’s lifecycle stage and evidence. High usage alone should not turn an onboarding problem into an upsell action.
firstBuild: A lifecycle brief with the reason attached
firstBody: Combine the first-value milestone, unresolved blockers, account ownership and a confirmed additional need. Let a person review the proposed next conversation.

rules.title: Assign the relationship owner
rules.next: Customer work needs one accountable owner across Sales and Customer Success.

rules.title: Resolve the customer blocker first
rules.next: Do not turn unresolved onboarding or adoption friction into an expansion pitch.

rules.title: Help the account reach first value
rules.next: Focus the next action on the agreed customer milestone rather than raw activity counts.

rules.title: Explore the next useful outcome
rules.next: Keep the conversation focused on adoption until a real additional business need is confirmed.

rules.title: Identify the sponsor for the new need
rules.next: A new use case needs a person who can validate its value and coordinate the next step.

rules.title: Capture the product learning
rules.next: Customer-zero work should produce a specific feedback item the product team can evaluate.

ready.title: Ready for an account-owner review
ready.next: The owner can review the achieved milestone, additional need and product feedback before choosing the next customer conversation.

experiments.name: Milestone-based onboarding follow-up
experiments.hypothesis: A concrete customer outcome produces more useful help than a generic check-in.
experiments.primary: Accounts reaching first value in the window
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

experiments.name: Need-confirmed expansion review
experiments.hypothesis: Expansion conversations are more relevant when a new need is verified.
experiments.treatment: Usage plus confirmed need and sponsor
experiments.primary: Accepted expansion discovery per reviewed account
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

roadmap.title: Map the lifecycle
roadmap.body: Agree on onboarding, first value, adoption and expansion definitions with Sales, CS and Product.
roadmap.measure: Stage consistency and known owner coverage

roadmap.title: Run the internal pilot
roadmap.body: Build reviewable next-action briefs and collect customer-zero product feedback.
roadmap.measure: Accepted actions, first value and repeated blockers

roadmap.title: Improve the full handoff
roadmap.body: Connect feedback to product changes and evaluate the lifecycle workflow with fixed cohorts.
roadmap.measure: Adoption, owner continuity and qualified expansion

records.name: Alder Cloud

records.question: What new outcome does the second team need?

records.name: Cedar Studio

records.question: What prevents the first useful outcome?

records.name: Willow Systems
records.context: High activity coexists with an unresolved workflow issue.
records.question: Which blocker needs attention before a commercial discussion?

records.name: Elm Design
records.context: Usage is healthy but no additional business need is known.
records.question: What outcome would make continued adoption more useful?

records.name: Birch Software
records.context: A new use case exists but its sponsor is unknown.
records.question: Who can confirm the value and coordinate the next step?

records.name: Juniper Analytics
records.context: The internal workflow revealed a rough edge that was not documented.
records.question: What concrete feedback should reach the product team?

metricsTitle: Activation and expansion need separate evidence.
metricsIntro: One synthetic starting cohort, with lifecycle milestones kept distinct.

rows: Owner and sponsor agreed next step

metricsNotes: Use the original cohort for overall activation and the relevant prior stage for a conditional conversion rate.
Usage is not revenue, and an accepted expansion discussion is not a closed sale.
Customer-zero feedback should identify a reproducible issue or improvement, not merely count agent activity.
aiApplication: At Kya, I would apply MCP analytics experience to first-value milestones and bounded agent proposals for onboarding, adoption or expansion. Each recommendation would carry its account context, unresolved blockers and owner, with results evaluated before promotion.
